questions.question: In his letter to the church in Rome, Paul said Jesus Christ was a descendant of which man?
In his letter to the church in Rome, how did Paul say Jesus was declared with power to be the Son of God?

answers.text: By His resurrection from the dead
By His teaching in the temple

questions.question: Paul wrote to the church in Rome that grace and apostleship were received through Jesus. What was this for?

answers.text: To call the Gentiles to obedience from faith
To guard the Law of Moses in Jerusalem
To build a temple for the believers in Rome

questions.question: Paul wrote to the church in Rome that he was not ashamed of the gospel. Why not?

answers.text: It is the power of God for salvation
It is the law of Moses for the Jews
It is the wisdom of the wise for all people
